The monthly bill job and the admin supplement no longer register a ticket for an order whose settlement amount is beyond the tolerance and no longer read the union-authoritative conclusion: in the same transaction the order is regenerated at the union settlement commission (savepoint, order-key lock, re-read, new commission version, re-judged) and enters the batch; a regeneration that fails or still mismatches is rolled back to the savepoint, alerts engineering and is counted in amount_mismatch_count. One run regenerates at most 500 orders (default; BillJobDependencies.regenerationCap is a test-only injection that production wiring does not set): the quota is checked before the savepoint and the lock, an order left for the next run is not locked, not batched, not registered, not alerted and not in the per-order results, and one warn event settle_regeneration_deferred carries the count. union_mismatch registration goes through ledger registerReconDiffWriteOnly (B2-02zf), which never reads recon_diffs. No migration, no contract change.
